run_metadata.coverage_summary: The environment's global outbound-egress block is unchanged and was re-verified this run: a direct curl to www.tenders.gov.au returns HTTP 403 'CONNECT tunnel failed' and WebFetch fails with DNS ENOTFOUND for every external host. The agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with an empty recentRelayFailures list, confirming a deliberate network-policy denial rather than a transient fault. As a result NO tender detail page or specification document on ANY portal could be opened, so EVERY recorded opportunity is headline-level only (all 3 counted in entries_pending_detail) with no deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/documents/contacts extraction. WebSearch (routed via Anthropic infrastructure, not the egress proxy) was the only working tool; it is US-indexed and lags the live Australian portals, returning mostly cached snapshots whose dates cluster in April-August 2026 (now in the past), so the great majority of Tier 1 rows surfaced were already closed and were not recorded. Despite that, an extended search surfaced three concrete, buyer-originated opportunities on Buying for Victoria (tenders.vic.gov.au) that are still open: two genuinely new this run - Goulburn Valley Water's EOI for the Tatura WMF HRAL lagoon remediation (opened 9 Oct, closing 17 Nov 2026) and the Country Fire Authority's VEMTC Water Management System EOI (closing 13 Nov 2026) - plus the Department of Transport and Planning GPSnet network-RTK positioning-software EOI (DOT46088, opened 16 Oct, closing 20 Nov 2026) re-confirmed as still open (first seen in the 2026-10-17 run). Tier 3 (mandatory) was checked - SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery and Brisbane City Council's Ariba portal exposed no publicly-visible open Australian RFx (registration-gated or invitation-only); their portals are retained in discovered_sources and no corporate opportunities were fabricated. Source discovery: three genuinely new buyer-originated sources recorded - Primary Health Tasmania (PHN commissioning/tenders page), Ararat Rural City Council (VIC, eProcure portal) and Cloncurry Shire Council (QLD, VendorPanel + TenderLink). Several promising items appeared only via paid aggregators (bidsmith.com.au, tendersontime.com) with no buyer-portal confirmation possible under the egress block - a WA Police acoustic-camera/AI system (closing ~12 Nov), NSW Dept of Education sponsorship EOIs (late Nov) and a Whole-of-Australian-Government electricity-services arrangement (~12 Nov) - and are logged in gaps as discovery signals only, not captured as tenders.
gaps: EGRESS POLICY BLOCK (global, unchanged): the environment network policy denies all outbound HTTPS to external hosts. Direct curl to www.tenders.gov.au returns HTTP 403 'CONNECT tunnel failed' and WebFetch fails with DNS ENOTFOUND for every host tested. Proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with zero recent relay failures, confirming a policy denial, not a transient error. Not retried per proxy guidance.

No tender detail page, specification document or portal listing page could be opened on ANY source, so all 3 recorded opportunities are headline-level only - deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, contacts and exact value/contract terms could not be extracted from primary sources. Every opportunity is flagged UNVERIFIED-AT-DETAIL pending an authenticated/unblocked detail pass.

WebSearch (the only working tool) is US-indexed and lags the live Australian portals, returning mostly cached snapshots with closing dates clustered in April-August 2026 (now past). Tier 1 portals (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, Tenders ACT, NT QTOL) could not be queried live; nearly all rows returned were already closed and were therefore not recorded as open opportunities.

Tenders SA (tenders.sa.gov.au): no open South Australian government tender could be surfaced this run; the live portal is unreachable (egress block) and searches collided with stale snapshots. SA Tier 1 effectively deferred.

NT QTOL (tendersonline.nt.gov.au) and Tenders Tasmania: only cached snapshots (closing dates Apr-Jul 2026) and aggregator pages surfaced; no currently-open opportunity could be confirmed against the buyer portals (unreachable). Deferred.

Aggregator-only discovery signals NOT captured as confirmed tenders (buyer portal unreachable to verify, per the buyer-originated rule): WA Police Force 'Acoustic Camera and AI System' (ref 46161524, closing ~12 Nov 2026) via bidsmith.com.au - pivot target is Tenders WA; NSW Department of Education sponsorship EOIs closing late Nov 2026 via bidsmith.com.au - pivot target is buy.nsw; a Whole-of-Australian-Government Arrangement for Electricity Services (deadline ~12 Nov 2026) via tendersontime.com - pivot target is AusTender. Re-check these on the buyers' own portals when egress is restored.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery and Brisbane City Council's SAP Ariba supplier portal exposed no publicly-visible open Australian RFx via search; individual opportunities are registration-gated or invitation-only and were NOT captured as tenders (portals recorded in discovered_sources only). Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated. Mining/retail/bank buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, CBA et al.) were not re-swept this run beyond the central Ariba check and are deferred.

Prior-run open items NOT re-checked this run (egress block; not re-verified so not re-listed to avoid implying fresh confirmation): Victoria Police prescription safety eyewear (T5956, closing ~9 Nov 2026), Ports Victoria Station Pier fender upgrade (T421509), DCCEEW Capacity Investment Scheme Tender 11 (WA renewables, closing ~22 Oct 2026). Treat as potentially still active and prioritise when connectivity returns.

GBEs (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water and other water/energy/transport corporations), universities/TAFEs/CSIRO, and public-health districts were searched but returned only closed or stale listings; no currently-open opportunity could be confirmed. Deferred to future runs when live-portal access is available.
recommended_seed_additions: Primary Health Tasmania (primaryhealthtas.com.au/what-we-do/commissioning/tenders) - Tasmanian Primary Health Network; publishes buyer-originated commissioning tenders for health/community services. Health-sector source worth monitoring weekly.
Ararat Rural City Council (VIC) - manages the majority of its tenders through the eProcure web portal; a regional Victorian local-government channel distinct from VendorPanel.
Cloncurry Shire Council (QLD) - administers tenders via both VendorPanel and TenderLink; a regional Queensland local-government channel.

Keep the Buying for Victoria sweep as the single highest-yield Tier 1/Tier 2 channel under the current constraints - it returns richer, better-dated rows in search than any other portal (this run it was the only source with confirmable open, future-dated opportunities), including water corporations (Goulburn Valley Water, North East Water, Goulburn-Murray Water) and statutory authorities (CFA).

Restore live-portal access (lift the outbound-egress block, or run an authenticated/unblocked pass) so that detail pages and specification documents can be opened - without it every run is limited to headline-level, search-cached rows and cannot extract deliverables, requirements or evaluation criteria.
